Ca2+-trigger fusion between single pairs of interacting vesicles is rapid and highly synchronous and that the temporal order of hemifusion and fusion is determined by the concentration of Ca2+.
Ca2+-triggering of vesicle fusion is a highly dynamic process with multiple steps and that complexin is a potent inhibitor of Ca2+-trigger vesicle fusion.
Ca2+-triggerd vesicle fusion is an all-or-none process and that the fusion pore can open in a stepwise manner.
